verses.en: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
verses.pt: Faze-me justiça, ó Deus, e defende minha causa contra a nação impiedosa; livra-me do homem enganador e perverso;
verses.en_web: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.
verses.en_bbe: Be my judge, O God, supporting my cause against a nation without religion; O keep me from the false and evil man.

verses.en: For thou art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.pt: Pois tu és o Deus de minha força. Por que tu me rejeitas? Por que ando em sofrimento pela opressão do inimigo?
verses.en_web: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.en_bbe: You are the God of my strength; why have you put me from you? why do I go in sorrow because of the attacks of my haters?

verses.en: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.
verses.pt: Envia tua luz e tua verdade, para que elas me guiem, para que me levem ao monte de tua santidade e a tuas habitações;
verses.en_web: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, To your tents.
verses.en_bbe: O send out your light and your true word; let them be my guide: let them take me to your holy hill, and to your tents.

verses.en: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.
verses.pt: E eu entre ao altar de Deus, ao Deus da minha maior alegria, e eu te louve com harpa, ó Deus, meu Deus.
verses.en_web: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.
verses.en_bbe: Then I will go up to the altar of God, to the God of my joy; I will be glad and give praise to you on an instrument of music, O God, my God.

verses.en: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
verses.pt: Por que estás abatida, minha alma? E por que te inquietas em mim? Espera em Deus, porque eu ainda o louvarei; ele é a minha salvação e o meu Deus. Instrução para o regente; dos filhos de Coré:
verses.en_web: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.
verses.en_bbe: Why are you crushed down, O my soul? and why are you troubled in me? put your hope in God, for I will again give him praise who is my help and my God.
